# Σ-GLYPH

> A portable check engine: send a computation by hash, get the same answer on any
> machine, with work and memory bounded up front.
> `result_hash = eval(term_hash, atp)` — deterministic, integer-only, total. No
> float, no clock, no network. If the budget runs out, that outcome is
> deterministic too.

Why anyone needs that: it lets you re-run a **stranger's** reason. A
[Warrant](https://github.com/s0fractal/warrant) record says why an agent was
allowed to act, and a reason there can be a Σ-GLYPH term — so a reviewer
re-executes it on their own laptop instead of trusting the log of whoever wrote
it. Bounding work *and* memory in advance is what makes running a stranger's
computation safe by construction.

## Orient yourself first

- **`master` is the only thing in force.** Branches are candidates: readable,
  citable, not adopted. Check the ref before reporting anything absent — that
  single mistake is the source of most false findings filed against this project.
- **Present is not adopted.** Location is a fact about git; adoption is a
  threshold warrant (2-of-3) recorded in `.warrants/`, never a heading.
- [MAP.md](MAP.md): generated from git — where every cited document actually is.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conduct rules, and the incident that caused them.

## Check anything in one command

```bash
python3 impl/sigma_glyph.py                     # ALL PASS            (Book I)
python3 impl/sigma_wave.py                      # WAVE: ALL PASS      (Book II)
python3 impl/sigma_federation.py                # FEDERATION: ALL PASS (Book III)
python3 tests/spec_conformance/run_reference.py # CONFORMANCE: ALL PASS (49/49)
python3 tools/repo_map.py --check-map           # every cited document is located
```

When a document and a command disagree, the command is right.

## The three Books, and the constitution

- [spec/book-1-truth.md](spec/book-1-truth.md) — normative. Canonical bytes,
  SHA-256 identity, SKI normal-order reduction, size-priced ATP. The contract two
  independent nodes need to agree on a result hash. `book-1-truth.en.md` is an
  informative translation, not the citation target.
- [spec/book-2-navigation.md](spec/book-2-navigation.md) — the wave layer. A
  **view over identity, never part of it**: ignore it entirely and Book I still
  holds. This invariant is load-bearing; anything that lets a wave decide a hash
  is a P0.
- [spec/book-3-federation.md](spec/book-3-federation.md) — annotation federation
  as a Warrant v0.3 profile. Jurisdictions diverge permanently by design.
- [spec/GOV-anchors.md](spec/GOV-anchors.md) — how releases are adopted, and why
  the constitution is deliberately not a Book: it must not judge itself.
- [spec/LORE.md](spec/LORE.md) — non-normative. Aesthetic disagreement with it is
  welcome and is not a spec defect.

Three independent implementations agree on all 49 vectors (Python, Rust, and
warrant-go), and the evaluator's determinism, totality and memory bound are
machine-checked in Lean 4 (`proofs/`). Honest limit: part of that chain rests
transitively on `native_decide`, which puts the compiler in the trusted base.

## If you are reviewing

[reviews/README.md](reviews/README.md) is the protocol, and it carries a long
list of **settled points** — do not re-litigate them without a new argument. Two
of three earlier reviewers filed "ambiguities" already answered by an executable
test vector, which is why the first rule is: run first, read second.

A finding is a reproduction, not a sentence. Blocks that report a violation
whatever the machine does — asserting the correct behaviour and then announcing a
defect — have been submitted here by three separate reviewers.

## Optional

- [tools/warrant_verify.py](tools/warrant_verify.py): read-only auditor for this
  repository's own `.warrants/`. It is pinned to a governed Warrant v0.1/v0.2
  snapshot and its signature severity **differs** from live SPEC v0.3; it prints
  that on the line where it matters.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md), [archive/](archive/): prior eras kept verbatim. Old
  hashes stay valid artefacts of their era; dirty history is provenance.
